_comment: Seeded trend signals (D31-style opt-in feature, see docs/decisions). One JSON file, one consumer: the Ideation Agent. Keyed by brand name so it lines up with data/brands.py. Free, static, hand-curated — not scraped, not live. Content-marketing angle categories that stay evergreen for a niche, not real-time trending topics.
Ridgeline Roasters: Behind-the-scenes: a day in the roastery, from green bean to bag
Sustainability angle: compostable packaging, supply chain transparency
Founder/team spotlight: introduce the person behind the roast
Educational: explain a coffee process (washed, natural, honey) simply
Seasonal tie-in: a limited origin or holiday sampler
UGC repost idea: customer's home pour-over setup
Cupping notes breakdown for the technically curious
Subscription/restock reminder framed as a ritual, not a sale
Local community angle: the shop, the neighborhood, the regulars
Comparison/education: single-origin vs blend, for newer customers
Sourcing story: the farm, the region, the relationship
Brew method tutorial tied to a specific bean in stock
Fieldnote Skin: Ingredient deep-dive: what one active actually does, plain language
Formulation transparency: why a percentage was chosen, not a bigger number
Refill/sustainability angle: less plastic per unit
Patch-testing education: how to do it safely
Myth-busting: a common skincare claim, addressed plainly
Routine-building: how one product fits a simple routine
Restock or sample-size availability, framed factually
Q&A roundup: real customer questions, answered directly
Reformulation story: what changed and why
Barrier-health education: plain explanation of a skin concept
Fragrance-free/sensitive-skin angle for a specific product
